decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line close to the core range costs little to carry, and architects keep specifying such lines for years, so the absence of website mentions in 2020–2021 does not signal a shortfall against aspiration.
This multi-model handle family adds system breadth that planners value, and with construction demand still solid there is no performance gap that would trigger problemistic search.
As a single design close to the core it is more exposed to range pruning, as Product C showed, but with no evidence of underperformance and low carrying costs the firm keeps it for now.
A lever handle family with several models supports the firm's integrated-system strategy, and its results appear close to aspiration, so withdrawal is not warranted.
The flagship electronic access system embodies the strategic shift toward digital building organisation, so strategic commitment and available slack justify keeping it despite rising material costs.
